newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Safex delays launch of currency futures.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Safex delays launch of currency futures.

text.p: The planned launch of rand/dollar futures and options contracts by the South African Futures Exchange has been postponed for a week, the exchange said on Tuesday.

The contracts, which were originally scheduled to start trading on Wednesday, would now begin trading on May 7 to coincide with the launch of the inverse contracts on the Chicago Merchantile Exchange.
Safex chief executive officer Stuart Rees said the decision to postpone the launch was taken by the exchange together with the Reserve Bank and the Treasury.
